final: WITH buckets AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT bucket_count, CAST(bucket_count AS REAL) / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share FROM buckets), kept AS (SELECT bucket_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(bucket_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(excess) AS average_excess FROM kept
